related.heading: Other True Aim products
related.platform: How the True Aim platform fits together

invoiceBenchmarking.name: Invoice Benchmarking
invoiceBenchmarking.summary: Every invoice, quote and estimate is checked against benchmark data, by business line and by region. Your team sees which lines are too high, by how much and why.

claimsDecisioning.name: Claims Decisioning
claimsDecisioning.summary: True Aim reads the claim, checks every line against the policy wording and prepares a full recommendation with the calculations shown. Your handler receives it and makes the final call.

damageReporting.name: Damage Reporting
damageReporting.summary: From the photographs and documents your customer sends, True Aim produces a priced damage estimate and the full scope of work at first notification. Your assessors go on site only where it changes the answer.

otus.name: Otus, True Aim's claims specialist
otus.summary: Otus sits next to you and brings you the claim, its recommendation and the reasoning that your company already uses. Handlers ask in natural language and get an answer straight away.
